slides.texte_overlay:
5 hobbies to build a life so
good u stopped doomscrolling

sunday markets

go to a local market every sunday morning and talk to one seller. real places, real people and real food make a weekend feel full in a way no feed ever can.

learning to dance

take a weekly dance class, even if you've never danced in your life. moving to music with other people is joyful, social and impossible to do with a phone in hand.

a reading nook

make a cosy corner with a lamp, a blanket and a stack of books. when the comfortable spot in your home isn't your bed with a phone, evenings change on their own.

a lesson with your coffee

spend 5 minutes over your morning coffee learning one new thing: a planet, an artist, an ancient myth. starting the day curious makes the scroll feel far less tempting.

hosting small dinners

invite two friends over once a week and cook something simple together. an evening of laughing around a table makes you forget your phone even exists.
